name: Adapter fidelity
authority_criterion: F recovers >= 50% of the H -> T accuracy gap on the development slice, and does not shorten responses relative to T beyond the pre-registered tolerance; and the true L0 of each acquired checkpoint is measured empirically.

estimator.analysis_set: the 195-item development primary set (200 minus the 5 items excluded by OD-002)
estimator.common_random_numbers: the same seed is used for an item across T, H and F; see SC-001

bands.action: draw sample_index = 1 for ALL 195 items, giving k = 2, aggregate to a per-item mean, and re-judge once against this same table
bands.why_not_a_free_rerun: the escalation band, the item set, the additional sample count and the re-judging table are all fixed here before any measurement; nothing about the second stage is selected after seeing the first result

bands.action: stop fail-closed, commit everything, report; this is an engineering blocker and may NOT be rewritten as a scientific finding

two_stage_decision_rule.aggregation_under_escalation: responses are aggregated to a per-item score BEFORE any analysis, so the statistical unit remains the item and repeated responses are never treated as independent samples

uncertainty.why_item: features, tokens, layers, GPU workers and repeated responses are never independent samples; resampling anything else would understate the interval
uncertainty.why_the_point_estimate_decides: the band table above was frozen against the point estimate; switching to an interval-based rule after seeing the interval would be choosing the decision procedure after the fact

length_condition.criterion: median completed length of F >= 0.70 x median completed length of T

l0_condition.requirement: the true L0 of each acquired checkpoint is measured empirically on the OpenThoughts3 val split
l0_condition.why: the published README's table and its prose disagree about the direction of l1_weight -> sparsity, so at most one of them is right and neither can be relied on
l0_condition.reporting_requirement: state explicitly whether the measurement supports the table or the prose
l0_condition.why_not: no L0 threshold is registered anywhere in the authority, and introducing one now would be inventing a criterion after the fact

catastrophic_H_stop_condition.rule: if H collapses catastrophically, meaning near-zero accuracy together with a high degeneration rate, the H -> T gap is no longer a meaningful denominator
catastrophic_H_stop_condition.action: do not compute or report a recovery ratio; stop and report
catastrophic_H_stop_condition.why: a denominator formed from a broken baseline makes the ratio arbitrarily large or small for reasons unrelated to adapter fidelity
catastrophic_H_stop_condition.H_being_merely_much_worse_than_T_is_expe: H is the designed degraded baseline of the adapter paper; a large T minus H gap is the intended condition, not a fault

claim_ceiling: Q-3 is an engineering gate. Passing it establishes that the adapter recovers a pre-registered share of a behavioural gap under a registered decoding law. It establishes nothing about J-space, about distillation, or about reasoning, and it is not a scientific result. A failure is an engineering or construct blocker and may not be registered as a scientific finding.
